SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trips, 
  AVG(CASE WHEN yt > 0 THEN yt::float / anglers ELSE 0 END) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 30 AND fish_date_doy <= 60
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 30
